name: autoheal_recovery_privileges
description: Verify the fixed host-service recovery capability installed by the project setup privilege broker; no runtime sudoers grant is created.

sudoers.rationale: Legacy setup-owned grant retained for explicit operator cleanup only. Runtime service recovery uses the root-owned privilege broker, and setup no longer creates this file.

storage.rationale: The grant is setup-managed host state, never scenario data.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.evidence: Windows does not expose the Linux host interface used by safeguard autoheal_recovery_privileges; the platform has a distinct host security and lifecycle model.

windows.evidence: Windows does not expose the Linux host interface used by safeguard autoheal_recovery_privileges; the platform has a distinct host security and lifecycle model.
